items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 4 at 1:27AM PST until November 5 at 10:00PM PST by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Seas 8 to 13 ft at 17 seconds and southwest winds 10 to
20 kt with gusts up to 30 kt expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Cape Shoalwater WA to Cape Falcon
OR out 10 NM, Coastal waters from Cape Falcon to Cape
Foulweather OR out 10 NM and Waters from Cape Falcon to Cape
Foulweather OR from 10 to 60 NM.

* WHEN...From 1 PM this afternoon to 10 PM PST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Strongest winds are expected this
afternoon. Expect a brief lull in conditions overnight.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
